STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_00042_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_00042_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_00042 (
    DATA_OUT, FULL, EMPTY,
    CLK, RESET, ENABLE, FLUSH, DATA_IN, PUSH, POP
);

    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 32;
    parameter ADDR_EXP = 3;
    parameter ADDR_DEPTH = 2 ** ADDR_EXP;

    input CLK;
    input RESET;
    input ENABLE;
    input FLUSH;
    input [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] DATA_IN;
    input PUSH;
    input POP;

    output [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] DATA_OUT;
    output FULL;
    output EMPTY;

    reg EMPTY;
    reg FULL;

    reg [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] memory[0:ADDR_DEPTH - 1];
    reg [ADDR_EXP:0] write_ptr;
    reg [ADDR_EXP:0] read_ptr;

    wire [DATA_WIDTH - 1:0] DATA_OUT;
    wire [ADDR_EXP:0] next_write_ptr;
    wire [ADDR_EXP:0] next_read_ptr;
    wire accept_write;
    wire accept_read;

    assign next_write_ptr = (write_ptr == ADDR_DEPTH-1) ? 0  : write_ptr + 1;
    assign next_read_ptr = (read_ptr == ADDR_DEPTH-1) ? 0  : read_ptr + 1;

    assign accept_write = (PUSH && ENABLE && !FLUSH && !FULL) || (PUSH && POP && ENABLE);
    assign accept_read = (POP && ENABLE && !FLUSH && !EMPTY) || (PUSH && POP && ENABLE);

    assign DATA_OUT = (ENABLE) ? memory[read_ptr] : 'b0;

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            write_ptr <= 'b0;
        end else if (ENABLE) begin
            if (FLUSH) begin
                write_ptr <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                if (accept_write) begin
                    write_ptr <= next_write_ptr;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            write_ptr <= 'b0;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            read_ptr <= 'b0;
        end else if (ENABLE) begin
            if (FLUSH) begin
                read_ptr <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                if (accept_read) begin
                    read_ptr <= next_read_ptr;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            read_ptr <= 'b0;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            EMPTY <= 1'b1;
        end else if (ENABLE) begin
            if (FLUSH) begin
                EMPTY <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                if (EMPTY && accept_write) begin
                    EMPTY <= 1'b0;
                end
                if (accept_read && (next_read_ptr == write_ptr)) begin
                    EMPTY <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            EMPTY <= 1'b1;
        end
    end

    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            FULL <= 1'b0;
        end else if (ENABLE) begin
            if (FLUSH) begin
                FULL <= 1'b0;
            end else begin
                if (accept_write && (next_write_ptr == read_ptr)) begin
                    FULL <= 1'b1;
                end else if (FULL && accept_read) begin
                    FULL <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end else begin
            FULL <= 1'b0;
        end
    end

    integer i;
    always @(posedge CLK) begin
        if (RESET) begin
            for (i = 0; i < ADDR_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
                memory[i] <= 'b0;
            end
        end else if (ENABLE) begin
            if (FLUSH) begin
                for (i = 0; i < ADDR_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
                    memory[i] <= 'b0;
                end
            end else if (accept_write) begin
                memory[write_ptr] <= DATA_IN;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule
